cases.review_rationale: Revise the methods=[RAD-Seq] association. The supplied Shao abstract establishes SNP discovery and linkage/QTL mapping but never identifies RAD, paired-end RAD or ddRAD library preparation. The metadata identifies the paper only, and membership in the grouped card Related Publications list does not assign it to the RAD-Seq member. Keep this abstract-checked background record and leave its method association unassigned (methods=[]) unless publication content establishes a scoped method. This finding concerns method attribution, not the validity of the reported SNP result.
